item.title: 【Kingsoft Office】Data Analyst Position (First Round)
item.description:
Date: January 7, 2026 Location: Online interview

Self-Introduction

Please give a brief self-introduction.

Technical Questions

I noticed two projects on your resume. Which one are you more familiar with?

  1. Tell me about the overall architecture and design approach of this project.
  2. What are the technical or business highlights of this project?
  3. How did you integrate Spring AI into the project?
  4. How did you connect to Ollama, and which model did you use?
  5. How did you define role models, what applications did you build, and how do you invoke them?
  6. Did you use streaming dialogue when working with AI? How did you implement it on the frontend and backend?
  7. I see you used Alibaba Cloud OSS in your project. Can you describe how you stored images? Also, discuss the pros and cons of other storage methods.
  8. Have you used Alibaba Cloud CDN or any other CDN services?
  9. Have you ever deployed a project? How do you deploy a project? If not, let me ask you: how would you deploy the frontend and backend respectively?
  10. What are some common design patterns? Discuss the advantages, disadvantages, and use cases of each. Which design patterns did you use in your project?
  11. What is MVC? What is DDD?
  12. What is Spring Security? How do you implement RBAC?
  13. How did you implement OAuth 2.0 authentication? What is the authentication flow?
  14. How do you cache data with Redis?
  15. I see your project uses JWT. How did you combine it with Redis to implement token renewal?
  16. I see you have a community feature. How did you design the post functionality for this community?
  17. How are post reply notifications sent? If you were to design it, how would you do it?
  18. I see your project uses knife4j, which is an enhanced version of Swagger. What is the difference between it and Swagger, and why did you choose to use it?
  19. In what scenarios did you use Apache POI? What is the difference between it and EasyExcel?
  20. Are you familiar with message queues like Kafka?
  21. What is RPC framework technology? How do you apply RPC framework technology?
  22. What are HTTP and HTTPS?
  23. Which version of Spring did you use? What are its new features?
  24. Which frontend frameworks did you use? Vue 3.x? (Please specify the minor version number)
  25. How did you use ECharts on the frontend?
  26. What is a route guard, and what features do route guards provide?
  27. Describe the table structure design of your project.
  28. What kinds of indexes are there, and how did you create indexes in your project?
  29. What window functions are available in MySQL?
  30. How do you use ranking functions? Can you give a brief explanation?
  31. What are the differences between the three types of JOIN (LEFT JOIN, RIGHT JOIN, INNER JOIN)?
  32. Which version of Java did your project use? Can you explain the JVM GC mechanism in that Java version?

Interview Preparation and Review Points

  • Deep analysis of project technical points: For each key technology used in the project, anticipate possible questions and prepare clear, specific answers.
  • Join the online interview early: It is recommended to enter the meeting link at least 5–10 minutes early to ensure your network, audio, and video equipment are working properly, creating a professional and reliable first impression.
  • Prepare materials before the interview: Keep your resume, project documentation, and relevant code snippets open for quick reference and precise responses to questions.
  • Timely review and consolidation: Immediately after the interview, record the questions asked, categorize and organize them, and refine your answers to continuously improve your expression and knowledge system.
